headline: US Escalates Economic Sanctions Against Cuba and Targets China-Based Suppliers
summary: The Trump administration has escalated its economic campaign against Cuba by targeting China-based suppliers supporting the island nation.
why: Geopolitical trade restrictions and sanctions against third-party suppliers can disrupt international supply chains and heighten diplomatic tensions.

impacts.name: Cuba
impacts.why: Escalated economic sanctions constrain Cuba's external trade and commercial activities.
